verdict.rationale: Puzzle's AI Close documents AI agents that review transactions and surface discrepancies during the month-end close, which directly covers the core of the story. The docs never mention spend-anomaly detection, duplicate-transaction flagging, or continuous ledger monitoring, so the extent of the capability is unproven. missing for 10: explicit duplicate-transaction detection, spend anomaly flagging, ongoing/continuous monitoring before close, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
